verses.text: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul, And all that is within me, [bless] His holy name.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩。）我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！凡在我裡面的，也要稱頌他的聖名！

verses.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget none of His benefits;
verses.textZh: 我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！不可忘記他的一切恩惠！

verses.text: Who pardons all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases;
verses.textZh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，醫治你的一切疾病。

verses.text: Who redeems your life from the pit, Who crowns you with lovingkindness and compassion;
verses.textZh: 他救贖你的命脫離死亡，以仁愛和慈悲為你的冠冕。

verses.text: Who satisfies your years with good things, [So that] your youth is renewed like the eagle.
verses.textZh: 他用美物使你所願的得以知足，以致你如鷹返老還童。

verses.text: The LORD performs righteous deeds And judgments for all who are oppressed.
verses.textZh: 耶和華施行公義，為一切受屈的人伸冤。

verses.text: He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the sons of Israel.
verses.textZh: 他使摩西知道他的法則，叫以色列人曉得他的作為。

verses.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, Slow to anger and abounding in lovingkindness.
verses.textZh: 耶和華有憐憫，有恩典，不輕易發怒，且有豐盛的慈愛。

verses.text: He will not always strive [with us], Nor will He keep [His anger] forever.
verses.textZh: 他不長久責備，也不永遠懷怒。

verses.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.textZh: 他沒有按我們的罪過待我們，也沒有照我們的罪孽報應我們。

verses.text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, So great is His lovingkindness toward those who fear Him.
verses.textZh: 天離地何等的高，他的慈愛向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！

verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our transgressions from us.
verses.textZh: 東離西有多遠，他叫我們的過犯離我們也有多遠！

verses.text: Just as a father has compassion on [his] children, So the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
verses.textZh: 父親怎樣憐恤他的兒女，耶和華也怎樣憐恤敬畏他的人！

verses.text: For He Himself knows our frame; He is mindful that we are [but] dust.
verses.textZh: 因為他知道我們的本體，思念我們不過是塵土。

verses.text: As for man, his days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.textZh: 至於世人，他的年日如草一樣。他發旺如野地的花，

verses.text: When the wind has passed over it, it is no more, And its place acknowledges it no longer.
verses.textZh: 經風一吹，便歸無有；他的原處也不再認識他。

verses.text: But the lovingkindness of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear Him, And His righteousness to children's children,
verses.textZh: 但耶和華的慈愛歸於敬畏他的人，從亙古到永遠；他的公義也歸於子子孫孫

verses.text: To those who keep His covenant And remember His precepts to do them.
verses.textZh: 就是那些遵守他的約、記念他的訓詞而遵行的人。

verses.text: The LORD has established His throne in the heavens, And His sovereignty rules over all.
verses.textZh: 耶和華在天上立定寶座；他的權柄（原文是國）統管萬有。

verses.text: Bless the LORD, you His angels, Mighty in strength, who perform His word, Obeying the voice of His word!
verses.textZh: 聽從他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，都要稱頌耶和華！

verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you His hosts, You who serve Him, doing His will.
verses.textZh: 你們作他的諸軍，作他的僕役，行他所喜悅的，都要稱頌耶和華！

verses.text: Bless the LORD, all you works of His, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul!
verses.textZh: 你們一切被他造的，在他所治理的各處，都要稱頌耶和華！我的心哪，你要稱頌耶和華！
